description: Chiggi Patches v1.13.1 — Nutrilio 'Local backup & restore' is now a single themed navigation row (no on/off switch) above Restore Backup that opens Nutrilio's built-in local file backup/restore (export all entries, images and settings to a portable .nutrilio ZIP; restore from a picked file; no Google account or premium). Apps: SonyLIV (com.sonyliv 6.23.1), Nutrilio (net.nutrilio 1.20.2), Threads (com.instagram.barcelona 434.0.0.41.74), Arrow Puzzle (com.easybrain.arrow.puzzle.game 1.7.0).
